newsitem.title: UK: Bridport-Gundry makes cash call, purchases.
newsitem.headline: Bridport-Gundry makes cash call, purchases.

text.p: Bridport-Gundry Plc said on Wednesday it has conditionally agreed to make acquisitions totalling 11.95 million stg.
The acquisitions consist of Militair Aviation Lt, Avery Flight International Ltd and Safetywear Ltd.
It also said it plans a 3 for 4 rights issue to raise 9.1 million stg.

Bridport-Gundry said it plans to buy Militair Aviation for 7.5 million stg, Avery for up 3.25 million and Safetywear for 1.2 million. Purchases will be paid in cash and shares. "These acquisitions will more than double the group's size and increase further our presence in the fast-growing, worldwide aviation market," said Bridport-Gundry's chairman David Sebire.
The cash element of the acquisitions is being funded by the rights issue of up to 8.06 million shares at 130p a share.
The group also announced that pre-tax profits for year ending July 31 had risen nine percent to 1.45 million stg on turnover of 30.3 million versus 28.4 million.
Bridport-Gundry manufactures medical, aviation and defence, sports and industrial and marine products.
